metadata.title: Secure Network

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability providing secure, resilient, and governed institutional network connectivity.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite Secure Network architecture composed of foundational transport, access control, segmentation, mediation, monitoring, egress discipline, and resiliency patterns.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Network configuration state, policy metadata, telemetry, and network security events.

props.name: dependency-class
props.remarks: Secure Network is a Tier-0 institutional dependency; loss or compromise has cascading impact across services.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Secure Network implements Zero Trust Architecture principles, eliminating implicit trust based on network location.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Secure Network aligns with Zero Trust Networking guidance, supporting identity-aware, policy-driven enforcement across all traffic paths.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Secure Network resilience is designed to anticipate, withstand, recover from, and adapt to adverse conditions, preventing cascading institutional failures.

metadata.remarks: Secure Network is the composite architectural pattern defining how institutional network services are designed, governed, and assured. It establishes secure connectivity without implicit trust, binds network behavior to identity and policy, enforces segmentation and mediation, governs outbound access, provides continuous monitoring and response, and ensures network resiliency. This composite pattern does not implement controls directly; it serves as the authoritative governance and assurance anchor for Secure Network SSPPs and subordinate solution patterns.
